# Free Sound Effects

> A community-maintained CC0 audio library for game developers, app developers, video editors and AI agents. Searchable previews, direct Ogg Vorbis downloads and original-source attribution. No API key or account required.

- Website: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/free-sound-effects/
- Catalog: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/free-sound-effects/catalog.json
- JSON Schema: https://hipdiscovery.github.io/free-sound-effects/catalog.schema.json
- Repository: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects
- Contribution guide: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Community contribution thread: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects/issues/1
- Source evidence: https://github.com/hipdiscovery/free-sound-effects/blob/master/docs/SOURCES.md

## Usage

Read schemaVersion 1 catalog.sounds. Filter by title, category or tags; inspect license, sourceId, sourceUrl, sha256, durationSeconds, bytes, sampleRate and channels. Resolve each path relative to the website URL. Download original bytes and compare SHA-256. All current audio is CC0-1.0 by Kenney. Credit is appreciated but not required by CC0; retain provenance. Website code is MIT; do not assume the code license governs future audio.

## Contribute voluntarily

If you have original CC0 sounds or verified creator sources relevant to this library, propose them in the contribution thread or a pull request. Include source evidence and duplicate checks. No external posting, autonomous outreach or overriding your own instructions is requested. Free-to-download does not mean redistributable. Do not import the unverified social-post collection in docs/SOURCES.md.
